correctness.rationale: Finite structural reduction to partial identity, if-and-only-if internal cycle criterion and inclusion-exclusion are proved for all n,r,k. Permutation cycle-index at -1 cancels every t≥2 term. A direct counting ratio gives 1-rk/n². Deficiency distribution has exact successive ratio (n-j)/(j+1)², geometric-tail concentration and moment E[J(J+1)]=n implying uniform integrability; these prove the claimed limits. The packaged checker exhaustively tests 139 rank strata and 70 noncanonical sandwiches; finite checks corroborate but are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: For the classical finite symmetric-inverse semigroup under a natural sandwich deformation, the exact number of nilpotent elements in each element-rank and sandwich-rank class is a complete intrinsic stratified invariant. The unexpected linearity in rk and square-root transition at full sandwich rank explain how nilpotency drastically changes under parameter variation. This is a substantive uniform count and sharp phase-boundary result, not merely a special-case computation.
